{{Quote|Drop your weapons and come with us quietly!|A CSF police droid holding two suspects at blaster point|<ref name="POP">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref>}}
The '''SS-410 Police Special''' was a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] utilized by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] that were fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==History==
The SS-410 Police Special was a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Blaster pistol/Legends|pistol]] issued to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[GU-series Guardian police droid/Legends|GU-series "Guardian" police droids]] for use in apprehending criminals, including instances where the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] deemed lethal force to be necessary.<ref name="SWEpolicedroid" /> During the [[Coruscant mandatory blackouts/Legends|Coruscant mandatory blackouts]], two [[Unidentified Guardian police droid|police]] [[Unidentified Guardian police droid 2|droids]] drew their blasters and attempted to arrest [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]] and [[Chata Hyoki/Legends|Chata Hyoki]] for attacking a Republic [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] named [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. However, the bounty hunters managed to shoot and overwhelm the police droids.<ref name="POP" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The droid blaster first briefly appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series episode ''[[Lightsaber Lost]]'', which aired on [[January 22]], [[2010]]. It appeared again in the episode ''[[Pursuit of Peace]]'', which aired on [[December 3]], [[2010]]. Later, it was mentioned in the police droid entry in the online [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|''Encyclopedia'']].
